name: Hasley Canyon Village
summary: Hasley Canyon Village is a Regency Centers community shopping center serving the growing Castaic area in northern Los Angeles County. With convenient hours and a strong 4.4-star rating from nearly 1,000 reviews, it provides essential retail, dining, and services to local families and professionals.
demographics: Hasley Canyon Village serves the growing Castaic community in northern Los Angeles County, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $125,000. The trade area draws young families and professionals who have relocated to this suburban area for affordable housing and quality of life, with a demographic skew toward households with children and dual-income earners. Shoppers typically seek convenient, everyday retail and dining options for weekly grocery runs, family meals, and essential services, preferring the accessibility of neighborhood shopping over trips to larger regional destinations.
description: Hasley Canyon Village is a community shopping center located in Castaic, California, serving the rapidly growing residential communities of northern Los Angeles County. Developed and managed by Regency Centers, a preeminent national owner and operator of shopping centers, this property exemplifies the company's focus on creating thriving neighborhood centers in suburban trade areas with compelling demographics. The center is strategically positioned along The Old Road, providing convenient access to local residents seeking everyday retail, dining, and service options. With operating hours from 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM, Hasley Canyon Village accommodates the busy schedules of working families and professionals in the area. The center has earned a strong reputation in the community, reflected in its 4.4-star rating from nearly 1,000 Google reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and its role as a valued neighborhood gathering place.
